title: Edit tags on selected links
limits: Up to 500 links per operation and 50 tags per link.
selection: {count, plural, one {# link selected across pages and filters.} other {# links selected across pages and filters.}}

effects.add: Add these tags to all {count} selected links. Existing tags stay.
effects.remove: Remove these tag names from all {count} selected links. Other tags stay.
effects.replace: Replace every tag on all {count} selected links with this list.

searchHelp: Up to 50 matches. Search to find any tag. Choose up to 50 tags.
searchFailed: Tags could not load. Search again to retry. Your chosen tags are kept.
summary: Apply to {count, plural, one {# selected link} other {# selected links}} · {tags, plural, one {# tag chosen} other {# tags chosen}}
confirmClear: Remove every tag from all {count} selected links.
success: Tags updated on {updated} of {selected} selected links. Unchanged links needed no update.
reviewHelp: Browse the {count} selected links below. Filters only change this review; the operation applies to the full selection.
matching: {count} of {total} selected links match this view.
emptyReview: No selected links match these filters.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to edit these links. Ask a workspace admin.
errors.not_found: This selection has expired or contains links that are no longer available. Nothing changed. Return to Links and select them again.
errors.invalid_input: Choose up to 50 tags, each no longer than 48 characters. Confirm before removing every tag.
errors.tag_limit: Adding these tags would exceed 50 tags on a selected link. Nothing changed. Remove some tags or select fewer tags to add.
errors.failed: Tag changes could not be saved. Your selection is kept. Try again.
